claims.quote: Several TBC1D24 variants are causally involved in the development of profound, prelingual hearing loss (HL)
and different epilepsy syndromes inherited in an autosomal recessive manner.

claims.object_text: postlingual progressive autosomal dominant hearing loss
claims.quote: Only two TBC1D24 pathogenic variants have been linked with postlingual progressive autosomal dominant HL (ADHL).

In four families, TBC1D24-related HL was found based on the identification of three novel, likely pathogenic (c.553G>A, p.Asp185Asn; c.1460A>T, p. His487Leu or c.1461C>G, p.His487Gln) and one known (c.533C>T, p.Ser178Leu) TBC1D24 variant.

claims.object_text: variants in TBC and TLDc domains involved in ADHL
claims.quote: Variants not only in the TBC (p.Ser178Leu, p.Asp185Asn) but also in the TLDc domain (p.His487Gln, p.His487Leu) are involved in ADHL development,
the latter two mutations probably affecting interactions between the domains.

claims.object_text: progressive hearing loss involving mainly mid and high frequencies
claims.quote: Clinically, progressive HL involving mainly mid and high frequencies was observed in the patients (n = 29).
TBC1D24-related ADHL originates from the cochlear component of the auditory system,
